title: Dresden Lock & Dam Catwalk
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION MISSISSIPPI VALLEY.ENDIST ROCK ISLAND.W07V ENDIST ROCK ISLAND
description_text: The US Army Corps of Engineers has a requirement at the Dresden Lock and Dam, in support of the Illinois Waterway Project Office. The requirements are for a catwalk to be used with the Generator at this location. The specifications for this catwalk can be found in the Scope of Work on the Solicitation when it is posted.
